prompt: Create a production raster PNG UI texture atlas for the Korean game Seoul Hero. Use the attached current runtime screenshots only as palette/context references. The current short-label buttons are MUCH TOO HEAVY. Design four NEW very thin, lightweight, refined contemporary Seoul operations UI surfaces. Transparent background, four separated assets on a spacious 2 by 2 grid, no overlap. TOP LEFT: a small square back-button surface, smoky blue translucent glass, softly rounded corners, incredibly thin pale blue-grey rim and delicate restrained corner reflection. TOP RIGHT: a wide rectangular auxiliary button, pearl ivory glass with blue-grey fine edging, minimal shadow, quiet blank center. BOTTOM LEFT: a wide rectangular tab surface, flat pale blue-grey enamel, fine continuous rim, tiny clean teal edge accent, nearly flat, quiet blank center. BOTTOM RIGHT: a wide rectangular primary action button, muted deep teal with navy-blue structure, ultra-thin pale rim and very restrained reflection, blank center. Wide assets should each be approximately 620 by 190 pixels; square approximately 200 by 200 pixels. All materials should appear as lightweight UI glass/enamel, suitable for display at 44px high. Fine rim should read as only 1px or 1.5px at display size. Absolutely no screws, no bolts, no rivets, no large metallic corner caps, no black bulky outline, no chunky bevel, no layered picture-frame borders, no mechanical sci-fi casing, no orange, no purple. No tray, no pedestal, no illustration, no icons, no text, no labels, no typography. Frontal orthographic UI surface, rectangular silhouettes, only very subtle depth. Preserve plenty of quiet interior for native text. Raster painted texture with minute smooth reflections, clean and sharp. Transparent canvas around the four shapes. Aim polished understated game UI rather than toy/cartoon buttons. Palette navy #243448, bluegrey #536B7E, ivory #EDF2F4, teal #267F75. Deliver one high-resolution alpha PNG atlas.
